name: native-note-capacity
goal: Preserve every valid verification entry in large Git notes across runtimes

evidence: The new batched note reader uses a variadic push for every verification in one note; Node rejects sufficiently large argument lists, so a valid large note can stop restoration.

The standard explanation-notes-order matrix covers many reason notes but only two verification entries. Extend it with a large valid repeated-verification note and verify the full count and order through the repository entry.
Committed test fac9153d failed with the actual Node stack overflow; record 3bcc37e0 preserves the command and assertion.
Commit f7e31e8c appends verification entries individually and moves batch orchestration outside the class limit.
The unchanged 150000-entry test passed at f7e31e8c; record 60f069f3 pairs with red 7be4d5c6.
